_comment: Scenario ids excluded from the Bridge bank. Round 1 (263, missing_problem_statement): the math problem itself never appears in the chat -- Bridge transcribes live sessions held over a shared whiteboard, and the worksheet was never captured. Round 2 (90, error_not_diagnosable_from_text): a second, sharper pass over what round 1 flagged as merely REFERENCING a figure, asking the question that actually decides inclusion -- can a tutor identify the student's error from the visible text alone? 11 of those 101 could (a student answering '4 m' to an area question has given a linear unit, which is diagnosable without seeing the rectangle) and were kept. Read by scripts/ingest_bridge.py; committed so the build stays deterministic.
